note.text: The video was made using AI, as seen in the warping letters on the side of the generator.    https://caniphish.com/blog/how-to-spot-ai-videos    Also, most EVs lock out the ability for the vehicle to drive when the car is charging.    https://www.tesla.com/ownersmanual/model3/en_us/GUID-BEE08D47-0CE0-4BDD-83F2-9854FB3D578F.html#:~:text=Tesla%20strongly%20recommends%20leaving%20Model%203%20plugged%20in%20when%20not%20in%20use.  https://www.woodhouseplacehyundai.com/ev-charging-faq/#:~:text=Yes!%20It%20is%20perfectly%20safe%20and%20appropriate%20to%20turn%20your%20car%20on%20while%20it%20is%20charging.%20Safety%20measures%20are%20in%20place%20that%20do%20not%20allow%20the%20powertrain%20to%20engage%20while%20it%20is%20charging.%20Therefore%2C%20you%20do%20not%20need%20to%20worry%20that%20your%20car%20will%20suddenly%20accelerate.%C2%A0    Moreover, inauthentic content goes against X's TOS.    https://help.x.com/en/rules-and-policies/authenticity#:~:text=You%20may%20not%20share%20inauthentic,we%20may%20not%20take%20action
